title: Maco-RL: Scaling Agent Capabilities with Mixed-Task Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Maco-RL：通过混合任务强化学习扩展智能体能力
abstract_en: Mixed-task reinforcement learning (MixRL) directly trains a unified policy across domains to continually expand agent capabilities without training separate specialists or requiring an extra distillation stage. Despite its appeal, scaling MixRL poses significant challenges in achieving stable and efficient mixed-task learning, effectively allocating rollout compute, and supporting continual domain expansion. To address these challenges, we propose Maco-RL, an approach that effectively scales MixRL. Specifically, Maco-RL employs a quota-based scheduler for asynchronous rollouts across multiple task domains, thereby stabilizing training by balancing gradient contributions and mitigating off-policy effects. Along an orthogonal axis, Maco-RL further introduces Tri-Buffer Sampling (TBS) to allocate compute among samples with varying levels of mastery, promoting sustained frontier exploration while preserving acquired capabilities. Experiments on five benchmarks show Maco-RL raises Qwen3.5-27B's overall score from 43.6 to 54.2 and then to 60.1 with continual expansion, reaching the frontier held by Qwen3.8-27B, which is further pushed outward by +5.7. Maco-RL also outperforms single-task RL with less compute for policy updates. These results support MixRL as a practical and compute-efficient post-training approach with substantial potential to strengthen general agent capabilities.
abstract_zh: 混合任务强化学习（MixRL）直接在多个任务域上训练统一策略，无需为各领域单独训练专用模型，也无需额外蒸馏，即可持续扩展智能体能力。但随着任务规模扩大，如何稳定高效地训练、分配轨迹采样（rollout）的算力，以及持续引入新领域，仍是关键挑战。Maco-RL 采用基于配额的调度器，为多个任务域安排异步轨迹采样，以平衡各域的梯度贡献，减轻离策略效应。同时，三缓冲区采样（Tri-Buffer Sampling，TBS）根据模型对样本的掌握程度分配算力，在保持已习得能力的同时持续探索尚未掌握的任务。在五项基准测试中，Maco-RL 将 Qwen3.5-27B 的综合得分从 43.6 提升至 54.2，并在持续扩展任务域后进一步提升至 60.1，达到 Qwen3.8-27B 的水平。应用于 Qwen3.8-27B 时，Maco-RL 又将其综合得分提高了 5.7 分。与单任务强化学习相比，Maco-RL 在使用更少策略更新算力的情况下取得了更好的表现。
key_points_zh: MixRL 用一套策略学习多个任务域，无需训练独立的专用模型或进行额外蒸馏。
配额调度器在任务域之间分配异步轨迹采样额度，平衡梯度贡献并减轻离策略效应。
Tri-Buffer Sampling（TBS）按样本掌握程度分配算力，在探索未掌握任务的同时保持已习得能力。
五项基准测试中，Qwen3.5-27B 的综合得分从 43.6 升至 54.2，持续扩域后达到 60.1；Qwen3.8-27B 的得分也提高了 5.7 分。
Maco-RL 用更少的策略更新算力取得了优于单任务强化学习的表现。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 核心贡献是利用多任务智能体的 rollout 反馈更新统一策略。配额调度平衡各任务的梯度贡献，三缓冲采样按掌握程度分配算力。摘要报告了五项基准上的量化提升，但未给出组件消融或量化的算力权衡。
